dependencyInventory.currentUse: Early migrations add cross-schema FKs to auth.users and invite triggers run after auth.users inserts. Staging seed code may read auth.users for nullable actor values.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep auth.users as the canonical provider user table.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Replace or retire FKs/triggers in forward-only migrations and preserve rollback mapping to legacy Supabase IDs.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: Server-only admin clients call listUsers, createUser, updateUserById and getUserById for invites, resets, user status snapshots and account linking. Admin clients disable session persistence and refresh.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep as server-only provider boundary with Fieldgrid authorization and audit before use.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Replace with first-party account administration APIs, password/recovery stores and user search endpoints.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: The current trusted session read is auth.getUser through Supabase SSR clients. The inspected code does not use getSession as the authorization boundary.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Continue using Supabase getUser as identity proof, followed by Fieldgrid tenant/profile authorization.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Replace every getUser call with a first-party session resolver and preserve server-side tenant binding.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: API server reads Authorization Bearer tokens, verifies with Supabase JWKS when SUPABASE_URL is set or SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET otherwise, then requires a sub claim. No explicit issuer/audience constraints are visible.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Document and harden Supabase JWT contract, including issuer/audience expectations and revocation tolerance.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Create Fieldgrid JWT issuer/JWKS or opaque API token verification with audience, scope, tenant and revocation semantics.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: Supabase auth cookies are host-keyed as fieldgrid-auth-{host}, path /, SameSite=Lax, production Secure and host-only by stripping domain. Backoffice tenant/support cookies are separate host-only cookies.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep host-only Supabase cookies and document trusted proxy/header requirements.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Replace with Fieldgrid session cookies, CSRF binding and server-side session storage.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: RLS and helper policies use auth.uid() to resolve tenant users, customer users, personnel, management users, report authors and Storage-linked personnel.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep Supabase auth.uid() semantics and add runtime DB/RLS evidence.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Introduce a principal mapping and rewrite policies/helpers or keep Supabase-compatible JWT claims during transition.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: Document Storage is management-policy plus app-mediated portal access. Assignment media Storage policies still bind storage.objects to assigned personnel through personnel.user_id = auth.uid() and path parsing.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep Supabase Storage policy semantics and add runtime Storage tests.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Bridge Supabase JWT semantics, rewrite Storage policies or move Storage access behind server-side service-role routes.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: Fieldgrid stores forced-password/reset metadata in Supabase app_metadata. Platform seed code writes app_metadata and user_metadata.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep metadata use but document policy, expiry and audit expectations.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Move metadata into first-party credential, recovery, invite and audit tables.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: Fieldgrid-owned invite flows create or update Supabase users with temporary passwords, send Fieldgrid email and link platform, tenant, customer or personnel records to Supabase user IDs.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep Fieldgrid-owned invite policy while Supabase verifies credentials.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Create first-party invite acceptance, verification and credential setup flows.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: Platform users store Supabase user UUIDs, roles, status and support grants. Platform screens enrich rows with Supabase admin snapshots.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep Supabase UUID as platform principal foreign subject.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Backfill platform_users to Fieldgrid principal IDs while preserving legacy Supabase subject mapping.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: Tenant users store Supabase user UUIDs and tenant memberships; RLS and app actions resolve active tenant membership from these rows.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Backfill to Fieldgrid principal IDs and update RLS helpers before cutover.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: personnel.user_id is a nullable unique Supabase Auth UUID. Invited personnel can be linked on first login by verified email when user_id is null.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep personnel.user_id as Supabase UUID and document one-time email claim risk.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Replace claim path with explicit Fieldgrid invite/identity mapping and migrate every personnel-bound RLS policy.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: customer_users.user_id links a customer portal account to Supabase Auth. Customer identity resolution is tenant and customer scoped, with a one-time email claim when user_id is null.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Keep customer_users.user_id as Supabase UUID and preserve tenant-bound app checks.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Migrate customer portal identity to Fieldgrid principal IDs and retire unsafe email-claim behavior after dual-run.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: React API client can attach Authorization Bearer tokens via setAuthTokenGetter. It does not read browser cookies or inject tenant headers automatically.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Continue requiring Supabase access tokens for native/API client calls.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Replace token getter input with Fieldgrid-issued access tokens and document mobile storage/refresh rules.

dependencyInventory.currentUse: Only the personnel app has a feature-flagged Supabase TOTP enroll/challenge/verify/unenroll UI. Customer security exposes password change only. Platform user MFA status is currently a later/not-active field.
dependencyInventory.optionAConsequence: Use Supabase MFA where enabled and define Fieldgrid policy separately.
dependencyInventory.optionBConsequence: Implement first-party TOTP, WebAuthn/passkeys, recovery codes, step-up and admin reset policy.
